<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/import_export_sum/"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



import_export_sum/ takes a region or state and a timeframe, then sums up each commodity
imported and exported from the origin separately for each year. This endpoint returns a CSV file containing the name of the origin, the commodity type if it is imported or exported, and the tonnage per year. Currently, this endpoint only works with domestic-traded commodities.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"in":"query","name":"destination","schema":{"type":"string"},"description":"The destination parameter accepts a string that must represent either a region, state, or an area outside of the U.S. The names corresponding to these options can be retrieved from the [NAME ENDPOINT].\n\nBoth destination and origin need to use either region, state, or one of the two can be an out of country area.\n"},{"in":"query","name":"flow","schema":{"type":"string"},"description":"The variable flow takes a single string value that represents the type of flow, which can be one of the following:\n\n- \"domestic\" – Represents a flow within the same country.\n- \"foreign-Import\" – Represents a flow of goods coming into the country from abroad.\n- \"foreign-Export\" – Represents a flow of goods leaving the country to be exported abroad.\n\nOnly one of these string values should be provided at a time.\n\nExample:\n- \"domestic\" will provide data related to goods or services that are within the same country.\n- \"foreign-Import\" will provide data related to goods or services coming from outside the country.\n- \"foreign-Export\" will provide data related to goods or services leaving the country.\n\nThe string value provided must exactly match one of these options to retrieve the appropriate data.\n"},{"in":"query","name":"origin","schema":{"type":"string"},"description":"The origin parameter accepts a string that must represent either a region, state, or an area outside of the U.S. The names corresponding to these options can be retrieved from the [NAME ENDPOINT].\n\nBoth destination and origin need to use either region, state, or one of the two can be an out of country area.\n"},{"in":"query","name":"timeframe","schema":{"type":"string"},"description":"The variable timeframe takes a list that can hold either one or two integer values for years, like the following [2017] or [2017,2025]. One year will give all the data stored for that year, while two years will give the value for those two years as well as each year in between the two.\n"}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
